text:
alex: heads up — thinking about partial/streaming rerank flows and how they should cost. If we stream early results for top-k, do we bill for all candidates sent or only those actually scored? wondering about telemetry/billing implications.
maria: product leaning: bill for attempted scoring. if customer asked for 100 candidates, that implies work.
sam: we can short-circuit before heavy model: run cheap filters -> run model on top-K. need clear API semantics: what's "probed" vs "scored"?
jasper: proposal: quota unit = model_score execution. If a candidate never reaches model (filtered locally/server-side pre-score), don't count it. docs + console must make this obvious.
leo: ops: must prevent adversarial clients sending 10k candidates. enforce input caps and pre-checks.
anya: console idea: per-route "cost preview" — set max_candidates=200 + model -> show estimated units and latency percentiles before saving.
alex: fallback routing q: if primary fails and fallback runs, which quota is charged? primary or fallback?
maria: charge the model that executed. record routed_to in telemetry for reconciliation.
sam: telemetry events proposal: rerank.request (route_hint, requested_candidates), rerank.dispatch (model, candidate_count), rerank.score (candidate_id,score,signed?), rerank.fallback (from_model,to_model,reason)
jasper: score envelope v2 suggestion:
```
{"score_version":"v2","scores":[{"id":"c1","score":0.72,"signed":"base64sig"}],"partial":true}
```
partial=true indicates streaming partial output; each chunk must be valid v2.
leo: signed scores need model-side signing. expensive on KMS/HSM; consider signing only top-N returned.
anya: console metrics: candidate_units_consumed vs returned_candidates; show ratio chart for SLOs.
alex: quotas enforcement options: hard reject, soft accept into probe bucket, or queued/backpressure. thoughts?
sam: prefer hard reject + clear error with cost estimate and link to console preview. avoids debt.
maria: enterprise/Dedicated can opt into queueing/backpressure as a feature.
jasper: routing heuristic: if candidate_count>50 prefer quantized-small model unless affinity override exists.
leo: alerting: if fallback rate >5% to cheaper model, page infra-team (may indicate capacity issues).
anya: UX: show fallback reason in console and suggested actions (increase reserved capacity, reduce candidates, change default model).
alex: signed top-N only + per-candidate billing ok? also define candidate ID TTL for score cache.
sam: cache_ttl default 600s (10m). cache hits = 0 units consumed and show cache_hit telemetry.
jasper: add API option example: `score_options:{signed:true,stream:true,top_k:10,cache_ttl_s:600}`
leo: security: include model_name+version+timestamp in signature payload to prevent replay.
maria: next steps: product/design to mock console preview and docs to explain counting semantics. eng: proto change for v2 envelope + ops playbook for fallback alerts.
alex: i'll file an RFC PR with envelope + quota semantics and link UX tickets. thanks all :thumbsup:
opsbot: deploy scheduled: reranker-config v3 -> staging at 4790012450
sam: noted, i'll add the telemetry events to tracer before staging.
anya: ping me for mockup review.
leo: i'll add a runbook entry for fallback alert thresholds.
